name: ipro-agent
description: Redesign a protein toward a stated goal by the IPRO procedure, with rotamer selection as a MILP.
long_description:
An independent, agent-drivable reimplementation of the published IPRO procedure (Iterative Protein Redesign and Optimization). Fifteen tools: read a structure, resolve design positions, build the rotamer-selection integer program, and run the loop. Everything runs on your machine.

This bundle does NOT install PyMOL. Rotamers come only from PyMOL's mutagenesis wizard and pymol-open-source is conda-only, so point this at an interpreter that already has it:

  conda create -n ipro-agent -c conda-forge pymol-open-source python=3.12
  conda activate ipro-agent
  pip install ipro-agent

Without PyMOL the server still reads structures and checks specs, and refuses to score or build the program rather than guessing.

python_path.title: Python interpreter that can import pymol
python_path.description: Usually <conda>/envs/ipro-agent/bin/python, with ipro-agent pip-installed into it. The server only sees what its own interpreter can import, so the wrong one means no design can run.
